name: Gwynant Mahjong
subtitle: Calm tile matching, no ads
promotionalText: Mahjong solitaire where every deal can be cleared. Six layouts from Garden to Turtle, with gentle hints when you need them. No ads, ever.
description:
Mahjong solitaire, calm and fair.

Match free pairs of tiles to clear the board. Every deal is built so it can be cleared, so you're never stuck with a board that can't be won.

SIX LAYOUTS
Garden, Pyramid, Fortress, Butterfly, Lantern and the classic Turtle, from a gentle start to a proper challenge.

MADE FOR PLAYING
• Clear, readable tiles in calm colours
• Free tiles stand out, so you can see your moves at a glance
• Hints when you need them, and unlimited undo

CALM BY DESIGN
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no tracking. Ever.
• Light and dark themes that follow your device
• Soft, optional sounds and gentle haptics
• Your game is saved the moment you leave
• Statistics for every mode, kept on your device

Gwynant games are free and open source, made with care in the spirit of Llyn Gwynant: quiet, simple and unhurried.
